item.title: 64 almshouses for over 55s are being built in Blackfrairs
item.description: A leading property developer, has broken ground on the almshouse development in Blackfriars, writes Tom Appleby… Almshouses are independent, low-cost housing units, designed for older people who have limited financial means.
